question: RUYQ is related to KNRJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, ORVN is related to HKOG. To which of the given options is LOSK related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is that each letter of the first term is shifted backward by 7 positions to get the second term.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e12e3926269f8b8344d7bffeb4fe06229d6df8c1b1f4eee2ebec1efbe957081.png] 

ORVN : HKOG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae7436deb7342dcb7c11116f8e465abdfe1990f6bd5d2e0a18ae040aa3529b92.png] 

**Applying the logic to LOSK:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53e83c7791488831d00572f18c54caeac94f43e82e5ce9e0ef382ed8e969223e.png] 

Thus, LOSK is related to **EHLD**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**.
